title: Instrumental variables with treatment clusters
abstract: arXiv:2611.13313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many policy evaluations include multiple unordered treatments. A common approach is to aggregate these treatments into clusters and apply instrumental variable (IV) methods at the treatment cluster level: The clusters are treated as binary treatments and the IV assumptions are invoked at the cluster level. This paper shows that IV with treatment clusters identifies a weighted average of local average treatment effects (LATEs) under a set of assumptions at the unclustered treatment level. When data on unclustered treatment choice is available, we propose testable necessary conditions for the causal interpretation of IV with treatment clusters. We illustrate our methods with empirical applications to the causal effects of fields of study aggregated into STEM and non-STEM clusters or eight broad study directions.

translated_title: 基于处理聚类的工具变量方法
translated_abstract: 许多政策评估涉及多个无序的处理（treatments）。一种常见做法是将这些处理聚合为若干聚类，并在处理聚类层面应用工具变量（IV）方法：将聚类视为二元处理，并在聚类层面援引IV假设。本文证明，在未聚类处理层面的一组假设下，基于处理聚类的工具变量方法能够识别出局部平均处理效应（LATE）的加权平均值。当未聚类处理选择的数据可获得时，我们提出了可用于检验基于处理聚类的工具变量因果解释是否成立的必要条件。我们通过对学习专业领域进行聚合——形成STEM与非STEM聚类或八个宽泛学习方向——的因果效应的实证应用，展示了本文方法。
tldr: 本文证明了在处理聚类层面应用工具变量方法可识别出局部平均处理效应（LATE）的加权平均值，并在数据可用时提出了检验该因果解释有效性的必要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that IV methods applied at the treatment cluster level identify a weighted average of local average treatment effects (LATEs), and proposes testable necessary conditions for the causal interpretation of IV with treatment clusters when unclustered treatment-choice data are available.
